en.answer:
If a <<7696>> affected by the effect of <<11623>> declares an attack, the "•" effect that prevents the opponent from activating effects is applied immediately since that moment.

Furthermore, since you can activate card effects, if a replay is triggered during that Battle Step as a result of a card effect of your own and the attack is stopped, the opponent can activate effects since that moment.
en.question: If a <<7696>> affected by the effect of <<11623>> performs an attack, from which point is the opponent unable to activate effects?
en.title: If a <<7696>> affected by the effect of <<11623>> performs an attack, from which point is the opponent unable to activate effects?

ja.answer:
「<<11623>>」の効果が適用された「<<7696>>」が攻撃宣言を行った場合、その時点からただちに『●相手はダメージステップ終了時まで魔法・罠・モンスターの効果を発動できない』効果が適用されます。

なお、自分はカードの効果を発動する事ができますので、そのバトルステップに自分が発動したカードの効果によって戦闘の巻き戻しが発生し、攻撃を取りやめた場合には、その時点から相手は魔法・罠・モンスターの効果を発動できる状態に戻ります。
